id: title:Gilbert09:keep known transient tiktok errors out of error tracking

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a dedicated method and tests to distinguish transient API errors from permanent ones in warehouse import workflows, potentially reducing unnecessary retry attempts for TikTok Ads warehouse imports.
review.reason: Adds a new method `get_retryable_errors` returning a set of error message prefixes, and adds two tests checking that paginator transient errors match these patterns while non-transient errors do not.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit and the specific implementation of the retry logic are not fully demonstrated in the supplied hunk; the score relies on the presence of the classification method and its tests rather than observed production behavior.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning a set of error message prefixes, and adds two tests checking that paginator transient errors match these patterns while non-transient errors do not.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help PostHog distinguish between transient API errors that should trigger Temporal retries and permanent errors that should not, potentially reducing unnecessary retry attempts for TikTok Ads warehouse imports.
